description:
Title: Becoming A Parent

Create a process that support in planning, taking and extending a maternity leave.  
* Fetch information about potential models (months duration, split between parents) 
* Let parent select 
* Collect relevant information 
* Notify Social Security, Company in time 
* Gather information from companies 
* At the end of the period let parent decide about extension.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/becoming-a-parent">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SocialSecurityNotification" name="Social Security notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyNotification" name="Company notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyInformation" name="Company information"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_BecomingAParent" name="Becoming A Parent" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Planning" name="Maternity leave planning begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Fetch</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchModels" name="Fetch information about potential leave models, including duration and split between parents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Fetch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Fetch_Select</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_SelectModel" name="Select a leave model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Fetch_Select</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_Collect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_Collect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_NotifySocialSecurity</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Notify Social Security in time" messageRef="Message_SocialSecurityNotification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Collect_NotifySocialSecurity</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifySocialSecurity_NotifyCompany</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCompany" name="Notify company in time" messageRef="Message_CompanyNotification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifySocialSecurity_NotifyCompany</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifyCompany_Gather</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" name="Gather information from companies" messageRef="Message_CompanyInformation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifyCompany_Gather</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Gather_Decide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_DecideExtension" name="At the end of the period, decide about extension">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Gather_Decide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decide_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DecisionMade" name="Extension decision made">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decide_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Fetch" sourceRef="StartEvent_Planning" targetRef="Task_FetchModels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fetch_Select" sourceRef="Task_FetchModels" targetRef="Task_SelectModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Collect" sourceRef="Task_SelectModel" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_NotifySocialSecurity" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifySocialSecurity_NotifyCompany" sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Task_NotifyCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyCompany_Gather" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompany" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gather_Decide" sourceRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" targetRef="Task_DecideExtension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decide_End" sourceRef="Task_DecideExtension" targetRef="EndEvent_DecisionMade"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BecomingAParent">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ParentProcess" name="Maternity leave planning" processRef="Process_BecomingAParent"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SocialSecurity" name="Social Security"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Companies" name="Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Social Security notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Participant_SocialSecurity" messageRef="Message_SocialSecurityNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifyCompany" name="Company notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompany" targetRef="Participant_Companies" messageRef="Message_CompanyNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyInformation" name="Company information" sourceRef="Participant_Companies" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" messageRef="Message_CompanyInformation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
